name: Accolade Mental Health
one_liner: Virtual therapy, coaching and help finding psychiatry, offered as an employer or health plan benefit by Accolade (now Transcarent).
best_for: Employees and dependents whose employer or health plan offers Accolade
People who want a care team to help them find a therapist or in-network psychiatrist
People who want mental health care coordinated with their other health benefits
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People whose employer or plan does not offer Accolade
People looking for a therapist they can book and pay for directly
short_description: Accolade is a benefits and care navigation service for employers and health plans that includes virtual therapy, coaching and help finding psychiatry.
long_description: Accolade sells health advocacy and virtual care to employers and health plans, and people use it through their benefits. Its mental health offering, launched in 2020, includes mental health coaching, virtual therapy and virtual psychiatry, and its care team also refers members to in-network psychiatrists and partner services. What you get depends on your employer's contract: one county employer, for example, lists Accolade Care therapy with copays waived and appointments within 5 to 7 business days, accessed at member.accolade.com. Transcarent completed its $621 million purchase of Accolade on April 8, 2025, and said the Accolade brand would be kept. No published study of Accolade's mental health service was found.

pricing.starting_price: Free through your employer or health plan
pricing.notes: Cost depends on your employer's contract; some employers waive copays for Accolade therapy. There is no self-pay option for the mental health program.

privacy.notes: Member health information is handled as HIPAA-protected; the website policy says it does not sell data for money but that analytics cookies may count as a sale or sharing under state law (opt out via cookie settings or GPC).

faqs.q: What is Accolade Mental Health and who is it for?
faqs.a: Accolade Mental Health is a digital health platform designed to support mental health and wellness.

faqs.q: How much does Accolade Mental Health cost?
faqs.a: Accolade Mental Health pricing varies. Contact them for current pricing.

faqs.q: Is Accolade Mental Health covered by insurance?
faqs.a: Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Virtual therapy through an employer benefit
Coordinating mental health with other health benefits

patient_summary: You can use Accolade only if your employer or health plan offers it; you start at member.accolade.com or by calling the number in your benefits materials. A care team can set you up with virtual therapy or coaching, or help you find an in-network psychiatrist. Many employers waive the cost, but check your own plan.

availability.note: Only through employers and health plans that contract with Accolade. Acquired by Transcarent in April 2025; the Accolade brand continues.
